Wat doe je? (mag leeg): What do you do? (may be empty)

LANcelot mag de micro niet gebruiken. Kl: LANcelot may not use the microphone. Click the padlock in the address bar and turn on the microphone, or connect a microphone.

You may quietly talk with your neighbour.
Overleg in je groepje, op een rustige to: Talk in your group, in a calm voice.
Rood: stil werken. Oranje: fluisteren. G: Red: silent work. Orange: whispering. Green: working together.
Sleep om groter of kleiner te maken: Drag to make bigger or smaller

Your class list is still empty.

Alles uit het lokaal halen en opnieuw be: Remove everything from the classroom and start again? With ↶ you can put it back.
